an10.22:1.1: athakho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ bhagavā etadavoca
an10.22:2.1: ye te ānanda dhammā tesaṃ tesaṃ adhimuttipadānaṃ abhiññāsacchikiriyāya saṃvattanti visārado ahaṃ ānanda tattha paṭijānāmi
an10.22:2.2: tesaṃ tesaṃ tathā tathā dhammaṃ desetuṃ yathā yathā paṭipanno santaṃ vā atthīti ñassati asantaṃ vā natthīti ñassati hīnaṃ vā hīnanti ñassati paṇītaṃ vā paṇītanti ñassati sauttaraṃ vā sauttaranti ñassati anuttaraṃ vā anuttaranti ñassati
an10.22:2.3: yathā yathā vā pana taṃ ñātayyaṃ vā daṭṭhayyaṃ vā sacchikatayyaṃ vā tathā tathā ñassati vā dakkhati vā sacchi vā karissatīti ṭhānametaṃ vijjati
an10.22:2.4: etadānuttariyaṃ ānanda ñāṇānaṃ yadidaṃ tattha tattha yathābhūtañāṇaṃ
an10.22:2.5: etasmā cāhaṃ ānanda ñāṇā aññaṃ ñāṇaṃ uttaritaraṃ vā paṇītataraṃ vā natthīti vadāmi.
an10.22:3.1: dasayimāni ānanda tathāgatassa tathāgatabalāni yehi balehi samannāgato tathāgato āsabhaṇṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti
an10.22:3.3: idhānanda tathāgato ṭhānañca ṭhānato aṭṭhānañca aṭṭhānato yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an10.22:3.4: yampānanda tathāgato ṭhānañca ṭhānato aṭṭhānañca aṭṭhānato yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti idampānanda tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ hoti yaṃ balaṃ āgamma tathāgato āsabhaṇṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti
an10.22:4.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda tathāgato atītānāgatapaccuppannānaṃ kammasamādānānaṃ ṭhānaso hetuso vipākaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an10.22:5.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda tathāgato sabbatthagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an10.22:6.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda tathāgato anekadhātuṃ nānādhātuṃ lokaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an10.22:7.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda tathāgato sattānaṃ nānādhimuttikataṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an10.22:8.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda tathāgato parasattānaṃ parapuggalānaṃ indriyaparopariyattaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an10.22:9.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda tathāgato jhānavimokkhasamādhisamāpattīnaṃ saṃkilesaṃ vodānaṃ vuṭṭhānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti
an10.22:10.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda tathāgato anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati seyyathīdaṃ ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarati
an10.22:11.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda tathāgato dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena …pe… yathākammūpage satte pajānāti
an10.22:12.1: puna caparaṃ ānanda tathāgato āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
an10.22:12.2: yampānanda tathāgato āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati idampānanda tathāgatassa tathāgatabalaṃ hoti yaṃ balaṃ āgamma tathāgato āsabhaṇṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati brahmacakkaṃ pavatteti
an10.22:13.1: imāni kho ānanda dasa tathāgatassa tathāgatabalāni yehi balehi samannāgato tathāgato āsabhaṇṭhānaṃ paṭijānāti parisāsu sīhanādaṃ nadati brahmacakkaṃ pavattetīti.
